mustTrumpSpadeTooltip: You cannot play this card (follow the lead suit, or trump with a spade when void)

playPhase.follow: Play a card (must trump if void)

tutorial.bidControls: In the bid phase, declare how many tricks (1-13) you expect to win.
tutorial.trickDisplay: The current trick. Spades are always trump.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. You must follow the lead suit, and you must trump with a spade if void.
tutorial.playButton: Press this button to play the selected card.
tutorial.scoreTable: Score table. Making your bid scores bid + 0.1 per overtrick (e.g. bid 4, take 5 -> 4.1). Missing the bid loses -bid points.
tutorial.bagsInfo: Shows each player's bags (overtricks). Each overtrick scores +0.1. Call Break has no bag penalty; the game runs for 5 fixed rounds and the highest cumulative score wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.

hint.bidEstimate: Bid based on high cards and spades
hint.mustTrumpWithSpade: Void: must trump with a spade
